quote_zh: 加强对化学危险品物流的跟踪与监控，规范化学危险品物流的安全管理
quote_en: Strengthen tracking and monitoring of hazardous-chemicals logistics and standardise its safety management.
notes: Regulation-for-safety wording (规范), coded S0 rather than R-demand.

doc_name: 物流业调整和振兴规划（国务院关于印发物流业调整和振兴规划的通知，国发〔2009〕8号）
quote_zh: 实行医药集中采购和统一配送，推动医药物流发展
quote_en: Implement centralised pharmaceutical procurement and unified distribution and promote pharmaceutical logistics.
notes: Mapped to 医药商业 (pharma distribution is the carrier of this logistics; judgement).

doc_name: 物流业调整和振兴规划（国务院关于印发物流业调整和振兴规划的通知，国发〔2009〕8号）
quote_zh: 加快发展适应国际中转、国际采购、国际配送、国际转口贸易业务要求的国际物流
quote_en: Speed up international logistics suited to transshipment, procurement, distribution and entrepot trade.
notes: Section 三(五) also 加快发展铁海联运; port and bonded-zone logistics. Mapped to 航运港口 (judgement).

doc_name: 物流业调整和振兴规划（国务院关于印发物流业调整和振兴规划的通知，国发〔2009〕8号）
quote_zh: 积极发展多式联运、集装箱、特种货物、厢式货车运输
quote_en: Actively develop multimodal, container, special-cargo and van transport.
notes: Section 三(二); infrastructure coordination in 三(七) (铁路、港口码头、机场及公路实现“无缝对接”).

doc_name: 物流业调整和振兴规划（国务院关于印发物流业调整和振兴规划的通知，国发〔2009〕8号）
concept_zh: 大宗商品物流（石油、煤炭、矿产品）
quote_zh: 加强石油、煤炭、重要矿产品及相关产品物流设施建设
quote_en: Strengthen logistics facilities for oil, coal, key minerals and related products.
notes: Also 加快发展粮食、棉花现代物流 and a coal logistics channel in 煤炭物流通道 (key project). Coal-transport channels are not separated from logistics here.

doc_name: 物流业调整和振兴规划（国务院关于印发物流业调整和振兴规划的通知，国发〔2009〕8号）
quote_zh: 加强应急物流体系建设，提高应对战争、灾害、重大疫情等突发性事件的能力
quote_en: Strengthen the emergency logistics system to respond to war, disasters and major epidemics.
notes: Key-area list in 三(四); also a key project (应急物流工程).

doc_name: 物流业调整和振兴规划（国务院关于印发物流业调整和振兴规划的通知，国发〔2009〕8号）
quote_zh: 发挥邮政现有的网络优势，大力发展邮政物流，加快建立快递物流体系，方便生产生活
quote_en: Use the postal network advantage to vigorously develop postal logistics and speed up an express-logistics system.
notes: Also 鼓励邮政企业深化改革…做大做强快递物流业务.

doc_name: 物流业调整和振兴规划（国务院关于印发物流业调整和振兴规划的通知，国发〔2009〕8号）
quote_zh: 推动汽车和零配件物流发展，建立科学合理的汽车综合物流服务体系
quote_en: Promote automobile and parts logistics and build a sound integrated automobile logistics service system.
notes: Key-area logistics list in 三(四).

doc_name: 物流业调整和振兴规划（国务院关于印发物流业调整和振兴规划的通知，国发〔2009〕8号）
quote_zh: 加快发展现代物流业，建立现代物流服务体系
quote_en: Speed up the development of modern logistics and build a modern logistics service system.
notes: Dedicated industry adjustment-and-revitalisation plan. Targets: 2009 ease firms' difficulties; 2011 build a group of internationally competitive large logistics groups; value added to grow above 10% a year. Also 加大国家对物流企业兼并重组的政策支持力度 and 防止盲目攀比和重复建设 (restraint side, minor).

doc_name: 物流业调整和振兴规划（国务院关于印发物流业调整和振兴规划的通知，国发〔2009〕8号）
quote_zh: 扶持一批物流信息服务企业成长
quote_en: Foster a group of logistics information-service firms.
notes: Section 三(八): also 加快行业物流公共信息平台建设. Mapped to IT services (judgement).

doc_name: 物流业调整和振兴规划（国务院关于印发物流业调整和振兴规划的通知，国发〔2009〕8号）
quote_zh: 建设货运服务型、生产服务型、商业服务型、国际贸易服务型和综合服务型的物流园区
quote_en: Build targeted freight-, production-, commerce-, trade- and comprehensive-service logistics parks.
notes: Judgement: wording is planned, targeted siting (合理布局物流园区) with explicit anti-duplication language (防止盲目攀比和重复建设), coded S0.

doc_name: 物流业调整和振兴规划（国务院关于印发物流业调整和振兴规划的通知，国发〔2009〕8号）
quote_zh: 加强物流技术装备的研发与生产
quote_en: Strengthen R&D and production of logistics technology equipment.
notes: Section 三(十) passing mention; also 大力发展大吨位厢式货车和甩挂运输组织方式, RFID/标准托盘. Mapped to 专用设备 (judgement).

doc_name: 物流业调整和振兴规划（国务院关于印发物流业调整和振兴规划的通知，国发〔2009〕8号）
concept_zh: 现代流通业（连锁经营与电子商务）
quote_zh: 积极发展连锁经营、物流配送和电子商务等现代流通方式
quote_en: Actively develop chain operation, logistics distribution and e-commerce as modern circulation modes.
notes: Section 三(一); the sentence also names 物流配送 (logistics row). L2 none: chain retail and e-commerce are not separated.

doc_name: 物流业调整和振兴规划（国务院关于印发物流业调整和振兴规划的通知，国发〔2009〕8号）
quote_zh: 大力发展第三方物流，提高企业的竞争力
quote_en: Vigorously develop third-party logistics and raise enterprise competitiveness.
notes: Also 鼓励生产和商贸企业…剥离或外包物流功能 and 培育一批适应现代制造业物流需求的第三方物流企业 (manufacturing-logistics linkage project).

doc_name: 物流业调整和振兴规划（国务院关于印发物流业调整和振兴规划的通知，国发〔2009〕8号）
quote_zh: 鼓励和支持物流业节能减排，发展绿色物流
quote_en: Encourage and support energy saving and emission cuts in logistics and develop green logistics.
notes: Also 鼓励企业加快发展产品与包装物回收物流和废弃物物流.

doc_name: 汽车产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 研究制订三轮汽车和低速货车生产企业向相关产业转型的鼓励办法
quote_en: Study and draw up incentives for makers of three-wheelers and low-speed trucks to convert to related industries.
notes: Same policy item: 落实汽车整车（含摩托车、三轮汽车、低速货车）生产企业退出机制 (motorcycles 801881 included in the exit mechanism).

doc_name: 汽车产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 大力发展专业的二手车经销企业
quote_en: Vigorously develop professional used-car dealers.
notes: Dedicated policy item (六). Regulatory side: 取消二手车交易市场的不合理收费; 加强二手车市场监管，严格经营主体市场准入.

doc_name: 汽车产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 鼓励加快城市轨道交通设施建设
quote_en: Encourage faster construction of urban rail-transit facilities.
notes: Peripheral item in the urban-transport-system policy; mapped to infrastructure construction (judgement).

doc_name: 汽车产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 实施新能源汽车战略
quote_en: Implement the new-energy-vehicle strategy.
notes: Target: 500,000 units of NEV capacity and about 5% of passenger-car sales; demonstration programme with central subsidies.

doc_name: 汽车产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 必须加快汽车产业调整和振兴
quote_en: The adjustment and revitalisation of the auto industry must be accelerated.
notes: Headline of a dedicated plan (target: 2009 output/sales above 10 million units). Support instruments: purchase-tax cut to 5% for cars of 1.6 L and below, 汽车下乡, scrappage subsidies, scrapping local purchase limits. Restriction side (minor): new vehicle makers and out-of-region branches only via acquiring existing makers; exit mechanism for non-compliant makers.

doc_name: 汽车产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 加快发展汽车研发、生产性物流、汽车零售和售后服务、汽车租赁、二手车交易
quote_en: Accelerate development of auto R&D, production logistics, retail and after-sales, rental and used-car trading.
notes: Dedicated task (八) 发展现代汽车服务业. List continues with 汽车保险、消费信贷、停车服务、报废回收; parking: 推动停车场建设，规范停车收费.

doc_name: 汽车产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 支持符合条件的国内骨干汽车生产企业建立汽车金融公司
quote_en: Support qualified domestic leading carmakers in establishing auto-finance companies.
notes: Also 促进和规范汽车消费信贷, securitisation of auto-loan assets. Mapping to 多元金融 is a judgement.

doc_name: 汽车产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 支持汽车零部件骨干企业通过兼并重组扩大规模，提高国内外汽车配套市场份额
quote_en: Support leading parts makers to scale up through M&A and raise domestic and overseas OEM-supply share.
notes: Also: 关键零部件技术实现自主化; 发展提升整车性能的关键零部件.

doc_name: 汽车产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 建立电动汽车快速充电网络，加快停车场等公共场所公用充电设施建设
quote_en: Build an EV fast-charging network and speed up public charging facilities in car parks and other public places.
notes: L2 left none: charging-equipment placement within 电力设备 is unclear.

doc_name: 汽车产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 建立动力模块生产体系，形成10亿安时（Ah）车用高性能单体动力电池生产能力
quote_en: Build a power-module production system and a 1 billion Ah capacity of high-performance traction cells.
notes: Quantitative capacity target.

doc_name: 钢铁产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 严格控制新增产能，不再核准和支持单纯新建、扩建产能的钢铁项目
quote_en: Strictly control new capacity; no longer approve or support projects that merely build or expand capacity.
notes: Dedicated plan, mixed: demand stabilisation, tech-upgrade funds, export-tax tweaks and M&A support sit alongside capacity control and scrapping (300 m3 and below blast furnaces; 72 Mt iron / 25 Mt steel by 2011). Dominant = supply control (judgement); L1-wide.

doc_name: 钢铁产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 积极推进河北司家营、山西袁家村等大型铁矿资源开发，提高国产铁矿石自给率
quote_en: Actively push development of large iron-ore resources such as Siyingzi and Yuanjiacun to raise domestic ore self-sufficiency.
notes: Also 鼓励有条件的大型企业到国外独资或合资办矿; 鼓励攀西、承德钒钛资源综合利用. Regulatory side: 规范进口铁矿石市场秩序. L2 mapping is a judgement.

doc_name: 钢铁产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 重点发展高速铁路用钢、高强度轿车用钢、高档电力用钢和工模具钢、特殊大锻材等关键钢材品种
quote_en: Focus on developing key steel grades: high-speed-rail steel, high-strength auto steel, high-grade power steel, tool and die steel, special heavy forgings.
notes: Sub-concept with opposite stance to the headline (product-mix upgrading). Also 高磁感取向硅钢 and extra-thick plate for nuclear/thermal power.

doc_name: 电子信息产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 加快培育信息服务新模式新业态
quote_en: Speed up cultivation of new information-service models and formats.
notes: Also 支持IPTV（网络电视）、手机电视等新兴服务业发展; 发展壮大涉农电子产品和信息服务产业.

doc_name: 电子信息产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 支持国内光伏发电市场发展和LED（发光二极管）节能照明产品推广
quote_en: Support the domestic PV power market and promotion of LED energy-saving lighting.
notes: Also 研究出台光伏发电和半导体照明推广应用的鼓励政策; thin-film solar cells in the components list.

doc_name: 电子信息产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 研究出台光伏发电和半导体照明推广应用的鼓励政策
quote_en: Study and issue incentive policies for promoting PV power and semiconductor lighting.
notes: Same sentence as PV.

doc_name: 电子信息产业调整和振兴规划
concept_zh: 工业控制与行业应用电子
concept_en: industrial-control and application electronics (RFID, auto, medical)
quote_zh: 支持RFID（电子标签）、汽车电子、机床电子、医疗电子、工业控制及检测等产品和系统的开发和标准制定
quote_en: Support development and standard-setting of RFID, automotive, machine-tool and medical electronics, industrial control and testing.
notes: Multi-item list (intensity 1); L2 none because items span several L2s.

doc_name: 电子信息产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 推动全国有线、地面、卫星互为补充的数字化广播电视网络建设
quote_en: Promote construction of complementary digital cable, terrestrial and satellite broadcasting networks.
notes: Also 加快模拟电视向数字电视过渡; 推进“三网融合”.

doc_name: 电子信息产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 突破新型显示产业发展瓶颈
quote_en: Break the bottlenecks of new-display industry development.
notes: Named major project (新型显示和彩电工业转型); 进一步完善并适当延长液晶等新型显示器件优惠政策.

doc_name: 电子信息产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 电子信息产业是国民经济的战略性、基础性和先导性支柱产业
quote_en: The electronic information industry is a strategic, basic and leading pillar industry of the national economy.
notes: Headline of a dedicated plan; broad concept spanning 电子, 计算机 and 通信 -> none; sub-sectors coded in separate rows. Six major projects named (集成电路升级, 新型显示和彩电转型, TD-SCDMA, 数字电视电影, 计算机提升和下一代互联网, 软件及信息服务).

doc_name: 电子信息产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 加快电子元器件产品升级
quote_en: Speed up the upgrading of electronic component products.
notes: List includes chip components, power electronics, hybrid ICs, lithium-ion batteries, thin-film solar cells, new PCBs.

doc_name: 电子信息产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 落实促进离岸服务外包产业发展的扶持政策
quote_en: Implement support policies for the offshore service-outsourcing industry.
notes: Also 积极承接全球离岸服务外包业务; 推动软件外包企业加快发展.

doc_name: 电子信息产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 推进视听产业数字化转型
quote_en: Advance the digital transformation of the audio-visual industry.
notes: Includes 支持彩电企业与芯片设计、显示模组企业的纵向整合 and 促进数字家庭产品和新型消费电子产品大发展; 加快电影数字化进程 noted here, not coded separately.

doc_name: 电子信息产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 增强计算机产业竞争力
quote_en: Strengthen the competitiveness of the computer industry.
notes: Also 积极发展笔记本电脑、高端服务器、大容量存储设备、工业控制计算机; 大力开拓个人计算机消费市场.

doc_name: 电子信息产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 提高软件产业自主发展能力
quote_en: Raise the independent development capability of the software industry.
notes: Named major project (软件及信息服务培育); target: software and information services from 12% to 15% of industry revenue.

doc_name: 电子信息产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 加速通信设备制造业大发展
quote_en: Accelerate the large-scale development of telecom equipment manufacturing.
notes: Named major project (TD-SCDMA 3G); 加快第三代移动通信网络、下一代互联网和宽带光纤接入网建设.

doc_name: 电子信息产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 完善集成电路产业体系
quote_en: Improve the integrated-circuit industrial system.
notes: Named major project (集成电路升级); continues the 2000 policy (国发〔2000〕18号).

doc_name: 纺织工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 加快推进产业用纺织品新产品的开发和产业化
quote_en: Accelerate development and industrialisation of new technical-textile products.
notes: Targets: geotextile domestic share 20% -> 50%; filtration materials 20% -> 50%; medical textiles; standards for use in infrastructure.

doc_name: 纺织工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 淘汰230万吨化纤落后产能
quote_en: Eliminate 2.3 million tonnes of backward chemical-fibre capacity.
notes: Also limits viscose lines below 20,000 t/y and wet-spinning spandex/acrylic processes. Other side: 支持化纤技术改造; 化纤差别化率由36%提高到50%左右.

doc_name: 纺织工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 淘汰75亿米高能耗、高水耗、技术水平低的印染能力
quote_en: Eliminate 7.5 billion metres of energy- and water-intensive, low-tech dyeing and finishing capacity.
notes: Also 制定并完善印染、粘胶行业准入条件，指导行业规范发展; promotes low-water dyeing technology.

doc_name: 纺织工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 加速淘汰棉纺、毛纺落后产能
quote_en: Accelerate elimination of backward cotton- and wool-spinning capacity.
notes: Specific obsolete equipment models listed in the policy section.

doc_name: 纺织工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 加大棉花、厂丝收购力度
quote_en: Step up purchases of cotton and raw silk.
notes: Price/farmer support via central reserves; agricultural side of the textile chain.

doc_name: 纺织工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 纺织工业是我国国民经济的传统支柱产业和重要的民生产业
quote_en: The textile industry is a traditional pillar of the national economy and an important livelihood industry.
notes: Headline of a dedicated plan: stabilise markets, technical upgrading, brand building, M&A, tax rebates. Restriction side recorded in separate rows (dyeing, cotton/wool spinning, chemical fibre); also 严防低水平产能的转移和扩张 and 纤维加工量过快增长的态势得到明显控制.

doc_name: 纺织工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 实施自主品牌建设工程
quote_en: Implement a own-brand building project.
notes: Target: about 100 brand enterprises; own-brand export share to 20%.

doc_name: 纺织工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 加快纺织机械技术装备自主化
quote_en: Accelerate the localisation of textile machinery and equipment.
notes: Target: domestic textile machinery share 60% -> 70%.

doc_name: 纺织工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 延伸中西部地区缫丝、织绸产业链，提高企业加工水平
quote_en: Extend the reeling and silk-weaving chain in the central and western regions and raise processing levels.
notes: Also 重点巩固提高现有200个中西部地区蚕桑生产基地 and 50 silk firms of the 公司加农户 type. Sericulture itself is farming; coded here under textiles (silk).

doc_name: 纺织工业调整和振兴规划
concept_zh: 高性能纤维及复合材料
concept_en: high-performance fibres and composites (carbon fibre, aramid)
quote_zh: 高新技术纤维和复合材料的产业化，总产量由目前的7万吨提高到14万吨
quote_en: Industrialise high-tech fibres and composites, doubling output from 70,000 to 140,000 tonnes.
notes: Quantitative target. Sentence starts 加速实现高性能碳纤维、芳纶…; also wind-turbine blades and aerospace preforms from high-performance fibre. L2 mapping is a judgement (carbon fibre may sit under either).

doc_name: 有色金属产业调整和振兴规划

quote_en: Speed up building a society-wide nonferrous metals recycling system.

doc_name: 有色金属产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 严格控制产能扩张，加快淘汰落后产能，推动上下游企业重组
quote_en: Strictly control capacity expansion, speed up scrapping of backward capacity and promote up/downstream restructuring.
notes: Headline of a dedicated plan; guiding principle 控制总量、淘汰落后产能、加强技术改造、推进企业重组; also stabilise markets (保市场稳定), 国家收储, 直购电 pilots. Dominant = supply control (judgement); L1-wide.

doc_name: 有色金属产业调整和振兴规划

notes: Also 大力开发新产品和新材料 for aerospace, defence and high-tech; target: high-grade copper/aluminium processed products broadly meet domestic demand by 2011; 支持中西部地区发展深加工.

doc_name: 有色金属产业调整和振兴规划
concept_zh: 有色金属矿产资源开发

quote_en: Step up overseas resource development and support qualified firms to run mines abroad wholly or jointly.
notes: Targets: raw-material security of copper 40%, aluminium 56%, nickel 38% by 2011. Also 鼓励大型有色金属企业投资矿山勘探与开发; stricter mining-right market access (regulatory).

doc_name: 有色金属产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 今后三年原则上不再核准新建、改扩建电解铝项目
quote_en: For the next three years, in principle no new or expanded electrolytic aluminium projects will be approved.
notes: Also scrap 800,000 t of small prebake-cell capacity by end-2010. Support side: 推进直购电试点 and 铝电联营 for leading smelters; 铝企业与煤炭、电力企业跨行业重组.

doc_name: 有色金属产业调整和振兴规划

quote_en: Strictly control new capacity in copper, lead, zinc, titanium and magnesium.

doc_name: 有色金属产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 逐步淘汰能耗高、污染重的落后烧结机铅冶炼产能

doc_name: 有色金属产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 按期完成淘汰反射炉及鼓风炉炼铜产能
quote_en: Complete on schedule the elimination of reverberatory- and blast-furnace copper capacity.
notes: 2009 target: 300,000 t of backward copper smelting capacity scrapped; copper named in 严格控制铜、铅、锌、钛、镁新增产能.

doc_name: 有色金属产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 2009年，淘汰落后铜冶炼产能30万吨、铅冶炼产能60万吨、锌冶炼产能40万吨
quote_en: In 2009, eliminate backward copper (300,000 t), lead (600,000 t) and zinc (400,000 t) smelting capacity.
notes: Quantitative target; also 完成淘汰落后锌冶炼产能.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划

quote_en: Focus on high-power power-electronics components, function modules and large precision bearings.

quote_en: Develop airport special-purpose equipment.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 重点提高汽车冲压、装焊、涂装、总装四大工艺装备水平

quote_en: Develop long-distance pipeline gas-compressor sets, large ball valves and control systems.

quote_en: Vigorously develop new mining, hoisting and washing equipment.
notes: Focus: electric-traction shearers, hydraulic supports.

quote_en: Focus on heat-, pressure- and corrosion-resistant steel (pipe) for power plants.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 大力发展污水污泥处理设备、脱硝脱硫设备、余热余气循环再利用设备
quote_en: Vigorously develop sewage/sludge treatment, denitrification and desulphurisation, and waste-heat/gas recycling equipment.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划

quote_en: [Support leading equipment makers] to offer value-added services in contracting, system integration, leasing, solutions and remanufacturing.
notes: Broad concept, no single SW industry. Target: manufacturing-services revenue above 20% of sales at large groups.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 推进电子信息装备自主化

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划

quote_en: Localise the equipment needed to make marine diesel engines, crankshafts, propellers, cabin and deck machinery.

quote_en: Ensure steady development of equipment manufacturing, speed up restructuring, strengthen innovation and raise localisation.

quote_en: Achieve domestic manufacture of high-speed EMUs, high-power AC-drive locomotives, heavy-haul wagons and large maintenance machinery.

quote_en: Push localisation of wind equipment, focusing on converters, bearings and carbon-fibre blades.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划

quote_en: Speed up the S&T major project on high-end CNC machine tools and basic manufacturing equipment.
notes: Named national programme.

doc_name: 轻工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 支持五金行业传统加工工艺及设备升级
quote_en: Support upgrading of traditional processing technology and equipment in the hardware industry.

quote_en: The food sector will eliminate alcohol and MSG processes and units below 30,000 t a year.

quote_en: Speed up replacement by energy-saving lamps and eliminate 600 million incandescent lamps of capacity.

doc_name: 轻工业调整和振兴规划

quote_en: Paper-making equipment will focus on wide-web, high-speed complete sets.

notes: Section 五; also 出台煤电、石化、煤化工等产能控制政策 (section 四).

doc_name: 中共中央 国务院关于完整准确全面贯彻新发展理念做好碳达峰碳中和工作的意见
